column1: # gc_sites.tsv - gin-control, the preparation stage: every call of gdakiTsSend, gdakiTsPump, gdakiHoldSend and every use
# of a peer's helper socket fd in gin-mirror ln4's host file (md5 0ab4e636; line numbers are ln4's), with its class and
# what the preparation stage did (impl/rs_ctrl_api.h). class: record (the rdma build carries it on the ring), rejoin (UD),
# data (outbox, store), witness (stays TCP in both builds), backend (the TCP back end itself). action: swapped (gdakiCtrlSend
# or gdakiCtrlPump), marked (gdakiCtrlFd), via-12987 (through gdakiHoldSend's swapped send), kept (ln4's text).
# build_gc.sh sites checks the pe.fd rows against ln4 and the marked rows against the tree's gdakiCtrlFd uses.
